preconditions.description: The number of destinations n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of corridors m must be between n-1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b and 0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor must connect two distinct destinations with energy requirements between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m lines, one for each corridor.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) <= 10**9 for line in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output line must contain an integer representing E_{max}(c_i) within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout[i]) == E_max(c[i]) for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each output line must correctly represent the maximum energy E_{max}(c_i) for the corresponding corridor c_i.
